item.title: A process-based screening framework for coastal reservoirs
item.content:encoded:
Communications Earth & Environment, Published online: 29 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s43247-026-04167-7

Reservoir geometries influence freshening while offshore wave statistics poorly proxy nearshore loads, showing that coastal reservoir suitability depends on coupled controls rather than hydrology alone, suggests a process-based screening framework applied to coastal archetypes in Taiwan.
